nHome.text: Home shows only the app's flagship features: My drive, Available offline, History, Recycle Bin, Docker Hub backup and Local access, each with a live status and one action. One card opens the required features page. Tweaks: accent, motion, stage (unlocked / locked). Being built by the Home and Local Tools implementation lane.

nTools.text: New tab catalog: every drive, view, tool and settings page with its open/closed state, own search with regex, Open every tab. Beside it the full regex builder with Create, Analyze, Test, Replace, Split, Grep, Debug, Library, Use. Try: mode tabs. Unbuilt modes say so. Tweaks: accent, motion.

ts.text: Docker Hub: one click, public, ciphertext only

nMain.text: Dense tool, not a Documentation site: drive tabs in the title bar, command bar, folder tree, sortable file table, inspector with the encrypted part map, versions and backup status, transfers strip, status bar. Try: click drive tabs and file rows. Tweaks: accent, motion, density. Built by the shell implementation lane; part map needs real part counts.

nUnlock.text: Unlock lives inside the locked drive's own tab. Try: Unlock (ring, green burst, shackle lift, card hand-off, files stagger in) and Wrong password (shake, error announced). Tweaks: accent, motion, stage. Windows Hello only if the app supports it.

nBackup.text: Side sheet over the workspace. One click backs up every selected current drive to public Docker Hub: sign-in, create repo as public, upload the on-disk ciphertext objects as layers, turn on hourly sync with 15 min retry. Honest warning: vault.json allows offline password guessing. Tweaks: accent, motion, stage incl. failure.

nSignIn.text: Every guided sign-in state with its one next step, plus the failure fixes P1 to P7 from the audit (reason reaches the panel, extra links no longer fail a good sign-in, old CLI prompt caught, stale sign-in can sign in again, status re-checks, retry after cancel, missing repo created public). Tweaks: accent, motion.

nMotion.text: The animation and transition editor: master switch, speed multiplier, profiles Calm/Standard/Expressive/Playful/own, 15 element kinds with live previews, per-kind duration, delay, stagger, distance, scale and easing curve, import/export JSON, reset. Reduced motion always wins. Try: profiles, speed, kinds. Tweaks: accent, motion.

nInstall.text: Dramatic installation takeovers. Success: confetti, ring, drawn check, real facts (what, where, exit code, time), auto-close countdown. Failure: red siren, exact command with secrets masked, exit code, last output, recovery steps; stays until dismissed. Tweaks: accent, motion, stage (success / failure).

nSettings.text: Settings with real groups, search and the adjacent regex builder strip, sound and comfort controls, high contrast and text size, and an honest required features coverage readout. Try: group list and the Regex button. Tweaks: accent, motion, regexOpen. Coverage numbers are a design placeholder until the inventory implementation lane lands real counts.

nMobile.text: 360 to 390 px: drawer for folders and views, drive picker, overflow chips for commands, search with regex, file cards, details as a bottom sheet. Nothing reachable on the wide screen is removed. Tweaks: accent, motion, sheet.

nSite.text: Documentation site gets its own editorial look: serif display, unmasking headline, drawn file-to-backup diagram, task-led What do you want to do grid, interactive part size explorer labelled Example only, cross-article search with regex. Tweaks: accent, motion.

nSplit.text: Dense tool for spreading encrypted parts across the main folder, a USB drive or another folder, and Docker Hub: locations with share weight and capacity cap, a split bar, copies with the plain one-copy warning, ordered rules, plan preview with files that would be unavailable, job phases (copying, verifying, releasing) and Apply, Cancel, Verify, Bring everything back. Safety backup (on by default) asks for confirmation to turn off and shows the held state with Retry. Mirrors: complete independently openable copies, same-disk note, up to date or out of date since a time, Update now, Verify, Remove. Tweaks: accent, motion, stage (setup / running / held / done), sameDisk, mirrorStale.
